newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Astra 9 mo seen 7 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Astra 9 mo seen 7 pct higher.

text.p: Drugs company Astra is expected to post a pre-tax profit of 9.81 billion crowns for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuters poll of 14 analysts showed on Thursday.
Thus, the market was expecting a 7.5 percent increase in profits from the 9.12 billion crowns reported in the corresponding period a year ago.
Forecasts varied between 9.56 and 10.00 billion crowns.
Sales were forecast at 28.51 billion crowns compared to 26.68 billion crowns a year ago.
For the full year, 1996 analysts forecast a profit of 13.20 billion compared against 11.12 billion in 1995.
The average forecast for 1996 has fallen by 350 million crowns since Reuter's last poll ahead of the half year report.
For 1997 the average of 12 analysts' forecast expected a pre-tax profit of 15.62 billion crown which means the average forecast has dipped by 200 million crowns since the last poll.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Enskilda, Fiba, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Grenfell, Paribas, Penser, Swedbank, Unibank, and William de Broe.
Astra's nine month report is due on November 4.
